original_test_intent: Validate each Type 39 Input Voltage Probe Handle as either the approved no-probe encoding or a unique reference to the intended Type 26 Voltage Probe for that same supply, stable across reboot.
original_method: Length-check Type 39, preserve the raw handle, resolve non-sentinel values against the complete Type 26 handle graph, verify probe identity/ownership and read-only status, then repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies the expected probe association/no-probe rule and approves reboot; no sensor threshold or power manipulation is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected voltage-probe handle/identity for each Type 39 supply
Applicable specification/version no-probe encoding and structure-length rule
Complete Type 26/39 raw parser and stable identity mapping
Read-only sensor source and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Use only read-only SMBIOS and sensor evidence; never alter thresholds, calibration or power state.
Do not accept a non-sentinel handle unless it uniquely resolves to a valid Type 26 record.
Verify supply/probe ownership rather than mere handle existence.
Stop on sensor, power or management failure; no automatic reboot retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate Type 39 length/raw handle, branch on the approved no-probe encoding, resolve non-sentinel references to exactly one Type 26 probe, compare ownership/status and diff across reboot.
Report dangling, duplicate, wrong-owner or drifting references without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the supply-to-probe topology, version-specific no-probe semantics and reboot plan.
Resolve intentionally absent/shared sensor designs and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep exposes only a formatted handle and cannot validate target type, uniqueness, ownership, length or no-probe semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw Type 26/39; emit Type 39 supply identity/raw handle, sentinel decision, resolved Type 26 identity/status/ownership and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The probe-handle scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no threshold/power change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build the complete SMBIOS handle graph, apply the version-specific no-probe rule, require each active reference to resolve uniquely to Type 26 and validate its supply ownership/read-only state across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing SMBIOS Type 39 and applicable Type 26 records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and sensor-interface versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Input Voltage Probe Handle and Type 26 Voltage Probe definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces handle text with length-aware, type-safe referential integrity and ownership validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects dangling, wrong-type, duplicate, cross-supply and invalid no-probe references.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved probe topology and no-probe rule.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A valid SMBIOS reference proves declared association, not calibration accuracy; active electrical stimulus is outside scope.

project_override_considerations: Projects may approve absent or shared probe topologies only when supported by the applicable standard/design; an override cannot make a dangling or wrong-type handle valid.
expected_evidence: Approved supply-to-Type26 map and no-probe/version policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 26/39 records, handles and lengths
Per-supply sentinel or unique type-safe resolution with ownership/status evidence
Statement that no thresholds, calibration or power state changed
Approved reboot/health record and post-reboot handle-graph diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The field is a defined cross-reference; no-probe and expected topology are execution inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Length, sentinel and graph resolution are fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds type-safe graph, no-probe, ownership and sensor-status validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its cross-reference safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates topology/version/reboot readiness and formal verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents any printable handle—including a dangling or wrong-supply reference—from being accepted as valid.
independent_technical_reasoning: A handle field is referential metadata: correctness requires applicable length, a defined sentinel branch or unique target of the required type, and semantic ownership by the same supply.
